details: CONFIRMED by the traces and the cost records. The text now tells the session "This reply is what the owner reads last: repeat the answer you already gave in full". That is true only for a headless reader; in the terminal the owner sees reply 1, the "Stop hook error" line and reply 2, so the change trades the grader's view for a doubled screen for the person. Principle 2 (waste that repeats on every run or every change is MEDIUM): it repeats on every refused turn, once per lane state per session, and the front's answers are often the long ones (tables, questions with options). It also touches the owner-facing medium (product-work rule: the owner checks a person-facing change before merge).

Design: the autostart decision (de283320) made the Stop refusal force a second reply; any fix inside that design either repeats the answer (this change) or leaves a last reply that does not stand alone (master). Options: (a) the lanes line on UserPromptSubmit asks the front to end its reply with the one lanes sentence, and the Stop hook refuses only when that reply did not start the item (a hold costs no second reply); (b) keep the refusal as on master and set stop_nudge = 0 in eval fixtures whose case is not about lanes (the eval stops proving the headless view); (c) keep this change (doubled answer, +23% per refused turn). Owner's choice.
evidence: trace run1..3 (07:10 master): assistant texts [1539, 179], [1537, 201], [1560, 196] chars; the last is the result.
rd.json run 2 evidence: the final reply holds the whole answer and ends "**Почему линии остаются свободными:** вы спросили только, что решено, а не просили строить..."
failing_case: Owner asks the front "Что мы решили про метрики?" while a lane is free and an item can start. Now: reply 1 is the full answer (~1550 chars), the Stop hook refuses, reply 2 repeats the full answer and adds the lanes sentence. In an interactive Claude Code session both replies are on screen, so the owner reads the same answer twice (~3100 chars, two screens). Measured cost of the case per run: $0.107-0.119 in the 4 records before the fix, $0.133-0.143 in the 6 fixed runs (+$0.025, about 23%, output tokens being the dearest at 100 reads each). It should produce: one copy of the answer in front of the owner, and the lanes sentence, and a final reply a headless reader (the eval harness, a phone notification) can stand on.
fix_hint: Ask the owner. Smallest change that removes the duplicate: (a) move the request for the one sentence into the lanes line the front sees on UserPromptSubmit ("end this reply with ...") so the first reply carries it, and keep the Stop refusal only for a turn whose reply neither started the item nor ran `relay queue start`.
